description:
LOCATION: crate-jmap-contacts-server/src/lib.rs:59-60

    /// Capability URI for `urn:ietf:params:jmap:contacts`.
    pub use jmap_contacts_types::JMAP_CONTACTS_URI;

PROBLEM:
The canonical sibling jmap-mail-server/src/lib.rs:45,48,51 defines its
capability URIs LOCALLY as `pub const &'static str` rather than
re-exporting from the types crate:

    pub const JMAP_MAIL_URI: &str = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:mail";
    pub const JMAP_SUBMISSION_URI: &str = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:submission";
    pub const JMAP_VACATION_RESPONSE_URI: &str = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:vacationresponse";

This crate re-exports from jmap_contacts_types instead. Two practical
contract consequences:

1. **Version coupling without justification.** A re-export makes this
   crate's public API surface depend on jmap_contacts_types's public
   API surface. If jmap_contacts_types renames or removes the constant
   (which IS its right as a sibling crate evolving independently),
   crate-jmap-contacts-server's API breaks. A local `pub const` would
   decouple the two crates here.

2. **Cookie-cutter inconsistency.** A consumer writing code against
   multiple jmap-*-server siblings sees the same URI advertised in
   different ways:
       jmap_mail_server::JMAP_MAIL_URI          // local pub const
       jmap_contacts_server::JMAP_CONTACTS_URI  // re-export
   These are observationally equivalent today but their visibility
   in the docs differs (rustdoc renders re-exports differently from
   originals), and refactoring tools (rust-analyzer "go to definition")
   jumps to different files.

WHAT CALLERS CANNOT DEPEND ON:
That `crate-jmap-contacts-server`'s `JMAP_CONTACTS_URI` constant
continues to exist if `jmap-contacts-types`'s constant moves or
renames. (Today this is a low-probability event; tomorrow,
post-publication, the coupling matters.)

RECOMMENDED:
Replace the re-export with a local definition:

    /// Capability URI for `urn:ietf:params:jmap:contacts` (RFC 9610).
    ///
    /// Include this in your Session object's `capabilities` map when
    /// the contacts extension is available. See RFC 8620 §2 for the
    /// session capabilities concept.
    pub const JMAP_CONTACTS_URI: &str = "urn:ietf:params:jmap:contacts";

Mirrors the canonical jmap-mail-server pattern at lib.rs:45-51.

PROPAGATION: this is a contacts-only divergence from the canonical.
The fix is contained in lib.rs of this crate; no other sibling needs
to change.

P3 because the failure mode is hypothetical (the types crate would
have to break its API) and the fix is small.
title: JMAP_CONTACTS_URI re-exported from sibling type crate instead of locally defined — diverges from mail-server canonical, ties API to types crate's major version
